name: GrowthBar
tagline: GrowthBar is an AI SEO tool that combines keyword research, competitive intelligence, and AI content generation. Users can see competitor rankings, generate AI-written blog outlines, and track keyword positions. Its Chrome extension surfaces SEO data directly on Google search results pages.
